stories.title: InvestingPro's Fair Value Tool Flags 62% Upside in Dime Community Stock

stories.title: Key ShinyHunters Hacker Detained in Jordan, Reportedly Cooperating
stories.summary: A key figure in the ShinyHunters hacking group has been detained in Jordan and is cooperating with investigators, Investing.com reported, citing sources. ShinyHunters has been linked to a string of high-profile corporate data breaches. The report did not name the individual or detail the scope of the cooperation.
stories.whyItMatters: ShinyHunters breaches have hit major companies and triggered costly disclosures, so an arrest could affect ongoing investigations and future attacks.
whatToWatch: Whether authorities confirm the detention publicly
Any new disclosures from companies tied to past ShinyHunters breaches
questions: Which prior breaches might this cooperation help clarify?
Will the individual face extradition or charges?

sources.title: Exclusive-Key ShinyHunters hacker detained in Jordan, is cooperating, sources say

stories.title: U.S. Reportedly to Lend Vistra $4.2 Billion to Expand Nuclear Power Output
